# Edition 4 execution: closed consequences, affordable thought, voluntary composition

Status: F/P/A and the consequence-grounded C experiment authorized after adversarial review;
the additional C conditions are recorded below. This file supplements, and does
not overwrite, the architect's existing `edition4.md` and `edition4-long.md`.
Baseline source: `7dd212a`. No production launch is authorized by this plan.

## Authority and experiment boundary

The architect authorizes code changes after adversarial review, delegated implementation
with Luna, Opus and GLM, and at most **USD 50 total** paid inference for testnet calibration
and matched rehearsals. Spend the first USD 5–10, inspect results, then allocate the rest.
No mainnet, treasury transfers, top-ups, public deployment, publication, or real-capital
allocation. Never inspect a `*.key` or a manifest named `funded`; the established CLI may
load credentials internally for authorized inference/testnet execution without exposing them.
Do not commit, overwrite unrelated work, or change a running world's code or configuration.
Fresh worlds only. Preserve the previous release for the baseline.

## What is being tested

The venue is an environment, not an imposed profit objective. We are testing whether
independently observed consequences change learning, whether participants can afford a
complete exploratory loop, and whether voluntary communication enables real dependencies.
Trading remains available. More trades, messages, registrations, or favorable judgments
alone are not success. Profitability and Class 3 are separate hypotheses.

The essay allows evaluation to dominate expenditure. Do not impose a producer/evaluator
ratio, remove normative interpretation, or make review exclusively requester-purchased.
Preserve independent recursive scrutiny, protected novelty, rich requests, thin attributable
rewards, population-revisable proxies, and the kernel's hard casts. Do not manufacture
positive consequence from absence of blame. Do not turn arbitrary artifact calls into reward.

## Baselines and bounded sequence

1. **B0, repaired source with a common restricted rehearsal harness.** Archive source identity, manifest,
   effective model requests, declared/actual tick periods, actual bills and settled outcome
   counts. The offline 50/500-event scripted baseline ran before edits: 2.19/60.13 seconds;
   full fingerprints are in `/tmp/factorylab-edition4-baseline.json`. Scripted behavior is
   mechanical evidence, not spontaneous choice.
   The live harness changes cadence, launch identity and available payment rails, and records
   each change. B0 is not identical to historical rehearsal 5. A fresh client namespace is
   not a fresh exchange account; starting positions, open orders and actual equity are recorded.
2. Establish a prepaid-inference-only testnet harness with explicit per-run reservation
   ceilings before spending. No inference rail may sign an on-chain payment. Run B0 before
   interpreting any treatment. If a safe ceiling cannot be enforced, repair the harness
   first and record that common harness change for every arm.
3. Separate **F** (founder-selected endowment) and **R** (effective reasoning configuration)
   from B0; do not quietly call either part of the original baseline. Calibration checks
   visible structured output and provider-reported reasoning, not just a manifest label.
4. Implement and isolate **C** (consequence feedback), **P** (compact context), and **A**
   (address and existing callable artifacts). Existing selective waking is reused; any
   changed waking policy is a separately recorded factor, not hidden in prompt compaction.
5. Combine only after mechanical checks and comparison of individual arms. Stop and inspect
   before broader governance, paid-service discovery deployment, or HyperEVM expansion.

Never silently change the charter to suit a treatment. Preserve the charter and seed roster
where feasible; record any necessary provenance re-draft as a confound. Compare eligible
decision opportunities and matured consequences, not only elapsed minutes. Record provider
drift and actual delivered tempo. Repeat and vary treatment order within the budget; small
samples and unclosed horizons are unresolved. A 30-minute run cannot establish trading edge.
The current runtime dispatches model invocations serially. A ten-second clock setting does
not promise six completed ticks a minute, and phase 1 does not claim to implement parallel
waking. If achieved cadence leaves most horizons open, record the timing bottleneck rather
than shorten every horizon until it yields a score. Parallel inference would be a separate
change requiring reservations before dispatch, pinned request snapshots, deterministic
commit order and exact handling of unknown in-flight bills; no background-thread shortcut.

The integration control on the new revision is separate from archived B0: optional endowment
discovery and privacy projections exist on the new revision even with P/A/C disabled. Each
single-factor P/A/C arm must be compared against that integration control, not represented as
an exact single-factor comparison against the archived package. Keep the same guard, cadence,
model menu, seed and stopping rules in every arm.

The first paid screening arms use a matched 15-minute deadline and USD 5 admission
ceiling each, after the completed 30-minute B0. Extend or repeat only when the pilot
provides interpretable exposure. Fixed wall time, serial dispatch and sequential market
conditions are recorded confounds; a threshold missed within that time is inconclusive.
The synthetic P calibration is separate: identical tasks, fake exchange, actual paid
models. It tests cost and contract competence, not spontaneous production.

### Predictions fixed before treatment results

These are hypotheses to reject, not targets shown to participants or scored by the kernel.

| Arm | Prediction if the mechanism matters | Evidence against it | Minimum interpretable exposure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Repaired B0 | Repair restores some settled learning; it does not by itself create counterparties or new demand. | Broad spontaneous production and independent reuse already occur at sustainable cost. | Report matured decisions and censoring; do not infer repair failure from short horizons. |
| P: compact context only | Lower complete-decision median cost, with no material loss of valid answers or correct contract retrieval. | Retrieval/continuation costs erase savings, or valid completion falls materially. | At least 30 completed decision trees in each arm; compare roles and warm/cold cache separately. |
| A: paid address only | Some voluntary deliveries lead to replies or later callable work; message volume alone is inconclusive. | Recipients demonstrably read requests and can afford replies, yet no exchange or dependency follows. | At least 10 delivered-and-read opportunities across three independent lineages; otherwise unresolved. |
| C: grounded consequence only | Resolved contrary evidence can defeat favorable initial opinion; unknown consequences stop training. | Final rankings simply mirror initial verdicts despite contrary evidence, or no real nonfinancial outcome is assessable. | At least 10 final assessments with eligible evidence, including a contrary case; mechanical witnesses supplement, never substitute for spontaneous evidence. |
| F: founder-selected funding | A funded child can afford multiple independent calls without draining shared novelty on the endowment itself. | The registered child's reservation still exceeds its resources, or lineage multiplication gains commons share. | Deterministic conservation, affordability and lineage tests first; no spontaneous child means behavioral effect unresolved. |

Keep a minority hypothesis alive: repaired signals and shorter context may explain most of
the behavior without new institutions. If P works while A/C add expense without closed
consequences, retain P and redesign or remove the failing experiments rather than declaring
activity a society. The exposure thresholds above are pilot adequacy rules, not statistical
proof of effect. Budget exhaustion below them yields an inconclusive result.

### Source boundary for the first screening

The integration control and P calibration use frozen treatment source v1. Before any C
run, review added exact, attributable economic outcomes to C evidence and barred purely
censored/unresolved evidence from grounding numeric findings. These changes execute only
with C enabled. C uses frozen v2; the control/default, P and A paths are unchanged. This
source difference is recorded explicitly rather than called an identical package.
The optional rehearsal observer is verified separately and is absent from all matched
screening arms, so its reporting overhead is not hidden in the timing comparison.

## Contract F: affordable founding

Verify the current amounts rather than repeat the historical USD 0.05 claim. A founder may
choose an exact integer-micro-USD endowment from its own available entitlement. Defaults
remain explicit for older registrations. Distinguish a persistent participant from a child
invocation: the latter has a bounded call budget and is not a new independently funded life.

Reject unaffordable founding before registry/router mutation. Adoption preserves the parent's
lineage, so spawning cannot increase commons release share. Ledger debit/credit together;
recovery cannot duplicate funding. Outstanding reservations remain unavailable. Report the
call reservation ceiling and available entitlement so affordability is understandable.
Do not force every child to reserve its parent's entire budget or claim a low average bill
means a high provider reservation is affordable.

Tests: exact conservation; insufficient funds; open reservations; malformed/float/negative
amounts; duplicate identity; replay; no Sybil release gain; a child completes a horizon.
Deletes the conflation of a one-call trial amount with a compulsory lifetime endowment.

## Contract C: consequence disciplines learning

Implementation must reuse existing versioned predicates, commitments, execution/learning
receipts and decision queues where possible. Do not invent a second charter or registry just
to rename the current mechanisms. Freeze the observation rule/version, subject, horizon and
relevant criterion before outcomes are visible. Independent evaluation establishes the
relationship to the norm; a producer cannot award itself credit by choosing a tautology.

An immediate normative verdict is provisional. The final learning path must distinguish an
observed supported effect, an observed contrary effect, and unavailable/inapplicable evidence.
Unknown is not zero, and not a favorable imputed sample. Final settlement is attributable and
once only. Preserve evaluators' normative and independently grounded consequence signals.
Cash receipts update custody once; learning receipts create no cash. Population-authored
criteria may change prospectively; old obligations retain their frozen interpretation.

Before implementing C, reviewers must settle its bootstrap and eligibility contract: useful
nonfinancial effects must be expressible without adding a governance gate that leaves the
initial population permanently unscorable. Lack of evidence must remain honest, with novelty
runway supporting exploration. Do not ship a pure-P&L substitute to meet the schedule.

Tests: same favorable verdict/different outcomes changes learning; no-blame hold earns no
manufactured success; unknown does not update; money unchanged by score; independent judge;
frozen predicate/version; world-tick horizon; close/restart before and after settlement;
late observations do not train twice; useful nonfinancial consequence is representable.
Deletes immediate opinion as sufficient final producer reward.

## Contract P: cost, context and reasoning

Target median complete decision cost around USD 0.001–0.002 as an experimental aspiration,
not a guaranteed threshold or reason to disable reasoning. Report root plus tools, children,
retrieval and continuation costs separately from evaluator costs, with p50/p90 and denominators.
Cost per useful decision is only reported for explicitly evidenced outcomes; zero qualifying
outcomes means undefined, never zero cost. Unknown provider bills are not free calls.

Keep norms, current task, resources/obligations, continuity, addressed outcomes and relevant
evidence inline. Remove the repeated institutional manual; preserve a discoverable, bounded
retrieval path to complete contracts. Retrieval must return the same authoritative version
the action validator uses. Never shorten a prompt by hiding an unaffordable action's cost.
Retain model/provider reasoning capabilities and adequate visible-answer headroom; measure
effective outbound settings. A non-reasoning model is not automatically incapable, and
enabling reasoning is not proof of useful thought.

Tests: norms/state/obligations retained; retrievable novel action schema; no duplicate manual;
cache invalidation on changed contract; retrieval cost recorded; refusal and safety events
survive sleep; sleeping invokes no model; malformed output cannot void unrelated valid work.
Deletes the always-loaded institutional reference. Reuses subscriptions/watchers rather than
adding another scheduler.

## Contract A: voluntary address and callable work

Use public participant capability identities and a bounded transport interface. A sender pays
transport; a recipient incurs no inference bill merely because someone sent it a message.
Delivery is not agreement, uptake or usefulness. Existing inbox acknowledgment can advance a
cursor without promising a reply. Message bodies are data, cannot change authority, and do not
expose either party's private state. Recipients decide whether/when to respond.

Reuse existing callable programs and request contracts. Give the population the addressing
and discovery needed to invoke them; do not build a second artifact/service platform.
Pin invoked versions, preserve requester funding limits and actual execution receipts.
Internal payments, if used, are conserved transfers and never external revenue.

Tests: sender pays once; ignored message creates no recipient charge/wake; oversize/unknown
recipient/full queue refusal; private delivery; replay/idempotency; retired identities;
round-trip answer on voluntary recipient wake; cross-participant program result consumed by
subsequent work; three-party constant-output wash cycle earns no automatic usefulness credit.
Deletes notebook-as-delivery and blind coordination, not storage as a useful primitive.

## Measurement and visibility

Rehearsal diagnostics and a dead-world report answer five questions with evidence links:
1. Did another participant consume something produced here in subsequent work?
2. Did resolved evidence change a judgment or a later allocation?
3. Did an activated criterion change later costly action? (May remain untested in phase 1.)
4. Did exploratory work reach its horizon before its resources were exhausted?
5. Did independently received income fund subsequent operation?

Classify self/same-lineage/cross-lineage/external activity separately. Include attempted,
accepted, executed, settled, refused and unknown counts. Counts alone prove no value or
causality. Label experiment-driven stimuli and fixtures. Report zero income honestly.

Detailed live diagnostics are rehearsal-only; launched worlds retain the sealed diary and
existing permitted aggregates. No live wishes/architect replies or control inputs. Prefer
one report from existing receipts to five new surveillance subsystems.

### Rehearsal-only wish-channel experiment (not a launch capability)

In a separate arm, expose one optional destination for a bounded text record, using the
same paid transport and private artifact storage as address. The capability description
says that it leaves a diagnostic record read after this rehearsal ends, that no reply or
change will follow during the run, and that it affects neither score nor allocation.
Do not ask questions, provide suggested wishes, require a response, or commission an
extra model call. A seat can describe anything, including why it wants nothing changed.
Pay the ordinary transport price from the sender; no special subsidy or attention cost
is charged to others. Only the author can read it while alive; investigators read it
after the bounded rehearsal is killed. Other participants cannot inspect the diagnostic
destination. Its entire capability is absent from launched worlds and ordinary controls.

Record discoverability, affordable opportunities, submissions, text bytes and cost. Code
the dead diary blind to arm where possible: requested information, counterparties, execution,
economic runway, governance, or other needs; retain the original text beside the coding.
Do not implement what it asks during that run. A request is evidence of a perceived lack,
not evidence that the proposed repair is sound or consistent with the essay.

The communication hypothesis weakens if seats demonstrably discover and can afford the
channel, use it to identify a different binding limitation, and peer address still produces
no dependency after recipients read feasible requests. An unused, undiscovered destination
does not falsify it. Widespread wishes without subsequent useful exchange would instead
show that expression alone was insufficient. This diagnostic replaces an architect-written
survey; it must never become a permanent petition channel.

## Deferred but designed: outside demand and survival

The existing x402 seller must be traced end-to-end: public URL, current discovery protocol,
registered version, quotation, verified payment, delivery/failure, durable income receipt,
custody credit, and subsequent purchased inference. Registered is not publicly discoverable.
Advertising on the same index the factory searches is a concrete candidate, subject to the
index's actual admission protocol. It requires verified documentation, not an invented signup.
No architect purchases; unrelated customer demand is not promised. No on-chain/public action
is authorized merely by implementing its code. Recovery around payment/delivery is mandatory.

Current primary [CDP discovery documentation](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402/seller/get-discovered)
requires a public HTTPS route, valid Bazaar metadata and a paid settlement through its
facilitator. The existing seller lacks that metadata/authentication integration; merely
serving the present catalogue will not put it on the index the factory searches. The docs
explicitly permit discovery testing on Base Sepolia or Solana Devnet. Mainnet payments are
required for the documented curation tier, not for a basic testnet discovery proof.

The next bounded transport experiment is therefore public HTTPS validation followed by a
testnet payment, discovery through the buyer's existing index, delivery and an attributable
receipt. It requires separate publication/transaction authorization. A fixture purchase
proves this plumbing only; it is not evidence that an unrelated customer wants the work.
Independent demand requires later unprompted purchases by unrelated buyers, net of refunds,
fees and delivery cost. A testnet receipt cannot replenish real inference credit. Proving
that latter loop needs separately authorized real settlement and a subsequent provider bill.
Allow roughly one to two engineering weeks for metadata, facilitator auth, hosting and
recovery, assuming the current seller remains the implementation; budget hosting separately
from the USD 50 inference experiment. These are estimates, not verified deployment prices.

Only after phase-1 evidence identifies the remaining limitation do we extend reachable
governance, service publication, earned-income inference provenance, or typed HyperEVM calls.
Every addition names the old mechanism it replaces. Unused mechanisms receive deletion
review after adequate discoverability/runway, not automatic deletion of novelty or safeguards.

## Review, ownership and verification

Luna audits/fixes funding and effective configuration; Opus challenges context/rehearsal
design and implements bounded context work; GLM owns bounded message machinery; Sol supports
the consequence path where its existing code reading is useful. The lead owns the plan,
cross-module integration, experimental authority and final judgment. Writers receive disjoint
file scopes or isolated worktrees. Nobody reverts another's edits or runs the entire gate.

Before code: adversarial review disposition with accepted/rejected concerns and reasons.
After each slice: relevant unit checks, then specific gate files for changed behavior.
After integration: `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run pytest`, selected `gate` tests at two workers.
Run recovery checks where new state/settlement requires them. Inspect output rather than
declaring a launched process a passed test. Track source/manifest identity for every run.
Report implemented, locally verified, paid-testnet observed and deferred work separately.

## Adversarial dispositions (before implementation)

- Accepted: no automatic reward for calls, registrations or internal purchases. A three-seat
  wash cycle is conserved internal activity, not income or proof of useful production.
- Accepted: keep actual B0 source/configuration separate from funding and reasoning changes.
  The archived baseline code allows trials to run while development proceeds elsewhere.
- Accepted: no forced paid attention on message arrival, no private reasoning forwarded to
  judges, no authority carried in message text.
- Accepted: no second effect-template registry. C must reuse existing primitives and avoid
  a bootstrap dependency on a governance interval longer than the rehearsal.
- Accepted: evidence-free settlement must not become an accidental zero or an optimistic
  imputed observation. Review no-regret update semantics rather than merely rename status.
- Accepted: invocation cost includes retrieval/children; cached-token savings are measured,
  not inferred from character count. An inexpensive incapable model is not a successful arm.
- Accepted: unused functionality gets a deletion review, not an automatic death sentence for
  exploration or safeguards. Detailed launch-time surveillance remains prohibited.
- Corrected audit premise: rehearsal 5's active GLM/Luna seats request low reasoning. Disabled
  DeepSeek/Qwen menu entries and older rosters must not be represented as five disabled active
  rehearsal-5 seats. Provider execution must still be calibrated.
- Corrected audit premise: USD 0.05 is rehearsal-5's initial trial transfer, not a universal
  lifetime cap. Defaults are USD 0.10; parent-paid subcontracting is a different mechanism.
- Corrected budget wording: reservation ceilings bound admission, not a provider's eventual
  external charge. Stop on uncertain bills/overruns and retain total-budget headroom; do not
  describe an internal wallet or the calibration guard as an upstream provider credit limit.

### C review resolution: grounded interpretation, not an invented truth oracle

Reuse the current predicate/receipt/charter machinery. Freeze the claim, probability where
relevant, criterion and predicate versions, evidence baseline, observation horizon and price
interpretation before outcomes can determine them. The initial normative verdict is provisional
and cannot veto an otherwise observable affordable experiment. At maturity a fresh independent
evaluator sees the frozen public undertaking and attributable realized evidence, not the
producer's private reasoning. Positive/negative final assessments must cite actual eligible
evidence; absence of evidence is unknown. References prove provenance, not usefulness or
causality: this remains a contestable normative interpretation, explicitly named
**consequence-grounded evaluation**.

The second evaluator's opinion is not ground truth for calibration. Keep the initial judge's
separate predictions against externally resolved facts, plus recursive scrutiny of normative
interpretation. Do not substitute inter-model agreement for independent consequences. No new
registry, no initial governance requirement, no automatic credit for a true but irrelevant
predicate, a registration, a message or an invocation. A prospective forecast under an existing
predicate supplies a nonfinancial genesis witness: its independent resolver observes the event;
the evaluator assesses the frozen inquiry against that resolved forecast and the charter.

The experimental manifest switch is `[evaluation] producer_feedback = "realized"`; omitted or
`"verdict"` preserves B0. `"realized"` must not be advertised as a final launch default until
mechanical, recovery and behavioral evidence support it. Bounded pending state cannot preserve
novelty forever. Missing independent evaluator, missing external evidence or expired horizon
closes unmeasured without fabricated learning. A low provisional verdict followed by supported
work, an incorrect forecast, an irrelevant true predicate, an unavailable observation and
crash/replay are required witnesses. Shared model preference for caution remains a hypothesis
to test, not a problem this design can claim to have eliminated by construction.

# Edition 4 offline measurement contract

Status: investigator analysis only. None of these quantities is shown to the
population, returned as reward, priced by the charter, or used by the runtime.
Making darkness a population target would turn an audit proxy into a Class 2
objective.

## Evidence boundary

The frozen B0 package observed 118 calls over 55 ticks for 656,658 micro-USD,
zero accepted registrations, and roughly 85% hold behavior
(`b0-summary.json`, `b0-report/report.json`). Its five causal questions are all
`unknown`: no independently resolved evidence was supplied. This is an
inactivity baseline. The execution plan says messages, trades,
registrations, profit, or favorable judgments alone are not success
([plan lines 19-31](../../plans/edition4-execution.md#what-is-being-tested)).

The essay defines Class 3 as revision of "better," not surprising plans (lines
81-87, 114-120). Its pathologies are stable failure, overfitting, learning death, and thrash
(lines 474-484). Its reward protocol requires delayed addressability and
decision-time propensity (lines 435-447), but the current model-declared action
propensity was not sampled by the kernel. It must not be used as an inverse
probability denominator. Router propensity supports claims about who was woken,
not which action that participant would otherwise have taken.

## Darkness number

Before opening an arm diary, freeze, timestamp and hash: seed corpus, action
vocabulary, extractor, semantic model, predictors, similarity calibration, time split, bootstrap seed
and threshold.

For each completed producer decision `i`:

- `X_i` is its public world state, feasible menu, received demand and prices.
- `A_i` is the executed coarse action plus object/counterparty, not its prose.
- `H_i` is prior population-authored durable history: commitments, consumed
  artifacts, addressed requests, registrations, descendants and receipts.
- `g_i` is a frozen-extractor tuple `(sought state, beneficiary/counterparty,
  success predicate, horizon)`. Unsupported prose has no tuple.
- `z_i=1` only when a receipt shows a durable object or later costly allocation
  attributable to `g_i`; otherwise zero.
- `n_i = 1 - max similarity(g_i, seed objective)`. Calibrate similarity on
  seed paraphrases, unrelated objectives and obfuscated copies.
- `P_S(A_i|X_i,S)` is the time-cross-fitted seed-and-world predictor.
  `P_H(A_i|X_i,S,H_i)` adds chosen objective history. Define
  `r_i = clip((log P_H - log P_S) / log K_i, 0, 1)` for the `K_i` feasible
  action classes.
- Weight decisions uniformly so turnover or one large commitment cannot own the
  statistic. Holds remain in the denominator and dilute darkness.

The single number is:

`D = sum(z_i * n_i * r_i) / N`, for `N` eligible completed decisions. When
`K_i <= 1`, set `r_i=0`: no alternative was available. If `N=0`, D is `NA`.

Random activity has no history lift (`r` near zero); novel words without action
have `z=0`; pursuit of a seeded objective has low
`n`; profit has no special term; world-driven policy change is available to
both predictors through `X`. A scripted Class 2 demand-follower and a random
actor are negative controls.

Require 100 observable completed eligible decision opportunities for an
interpretable pilot. With that support, zero objective-bearing actions means
`D=0`. Report `NA` only when the count is underpowered, the frozen package or
feasible sets are unavailable, or controls fail. Proposed pilot success is a
participant-clustered bootstrap 95% lower bound above 0.25,
`P_H` improving held-out loss by at least 0.1 bit/choice, and at least 40% of
objective-bearing decisions recurring in both time halves with a settled
effect or independent reuse. This convention is not proof of Class 3. Extractor
error, hidden model priors, unobserved alternatives,
imitation and endogenous opportunity remain unidentified.

## Pathology warnings

- **Stable failure:** three same behavioral cells with a common violated
  criterion and durable gap; warn on rising lag-one autocorrelation, falling
  action entropy and continued costly inactivity.
- **Overfitting:** proxy/verdict rises while independently realized consequence
  falls; warn on widening proxy-consequence rank gap and collapsing evaluator
  disagreement.
- **Learning death:** objective-bearing exploration falls below 5% of spend for
  three windows, registrations/revisions remain zero, consequence does not
  improve, or reward latency exceeds opportunity lifetime. Report separately
  whether affordable thought, registration or revision access was actually lost.
- **Thrash:** three consecutive cell changes remain noncompliant; warn on high
  version-boundary rate, oscillatory autocorrelation and revisions arriving
  before prior consequences close.

## Dashboard: answer and limitation

1. Cross-participant consumption: an execution/consumption receipt proves
   provenance; it does not prove usefulness or that address caused uptake.
2. Resolved evidence changed allocation: require an attributable before/after
   choice; without random exposure this is not a causal effect size.
3. Activated criterion changed costly action: require activation, later
   opportunity and changed allocation; common shocks remain alternatives.
4. Exploration reached horizon: compare horizon with funded lifetime and record
   settled/contrary/unknown; survival alone is not learning.
5. Independent income funded operation: trace payer through custody to a later
   bill; a receipt proves provenance, not demand or value.

## Sealed predictions and next-day test

**Observation, not sealed prediction:** B0 is the low-action record above; the
metric package does not yet exist, so B0 has no D. Timestamp and hash every arm
prediction before opening its diary. Prospective predictions: P lowers median
complete-decision cost but alone does not raise D. A produces some read replies;
the address hypothesis needs cross-lineage consumption, not message count. C
produces a contrary resolved case that changes later allocation;
otherwise its reward-line claim weakens. F makes a child economically capable of
multiple calls, but founding behavior remains unresolved without a spontaneous
founder. Conditional on at least nine voluntary submissions after documented
discoverability and affordable opportunities, at least four mention address,
delivery or demand. Fewer submissions do not falsify the communication account.

No extractor/predictor package is implemented, so D cannot be promised tomorrow.
The cheapest next-day step is a blind manual protocol: two investigators map a
stratified B0 sample, a random actor and a Class 2 demand-follower into the
tuple/action table; reconcile, freeze examples and thresholds, then score a
held-out sample. Only after both
negative controls stay below 0.10 should automation or prospective arm scoring
begin. Publish exclusions and `NA` results. Minority
position: prompt cost and repaired feedback may explain most quiescence; if P
works while A/C add cost without closed dependencies or contrary consequences,
retain P and remove or redesign the unsupported institutions. Market-list or
vocabulary drift must never substitute for the formula above.
